name: puzzletide-mcp

tools.name: eval_check
tools.description: Grades a JSON answers file against a tasks file produced by eval generate. Verification is by construction: sudoku answers must satisfy sudoku rules and preserve the givens; word search answers must spell the word along a straight line in the grid. Outputs per-task results and a score summary.

tools.name: eval_generate
tools.description: Emits a JSON array of puzzle tasks with objectively checkable answers. Types: sudoku (unique-solution puzzles; answers verified against sudoku rules + givens) and wordsearch (answers verified against the grid letters). Deterministic with --seed, so a (seed, type, difficulty, n) tuple names a reproducible benchmark set.

type.description: Task type: sudoku or wordsearch (default: sudoku)

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible task set (default: 1)

out.description: Write tasks JSON to a file instead of stdout

tools.name: play_daily
tools.description: Prints a daily sudoku (medium difficulty) that is the same for everyone on the same UTC calendar day. Solve more puzzles at puzzletide.com.

tools.name: puzzle_crossword_generate
tools.description: Builds an interlocking crossword grid with standard numbering. Words come from --words "WORD: clue; WORD2: clue2", --file (JSON [{word,clue}] or "WORD: clue" lines), or --theme (clues are auto-generated puzzle-style hints). Words that cannot interlock are reported as unplaced. Deterministic with --seed. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/crossword

file.description: JSON array of {word, clue} or "WORD: clue" lines

theme.description: Use a bundled word bank theme (auto-generated clues)

count.description: Number of words to use from the theme/file (default: 10)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output (number or word)

svg.description: Also write an SVG image to <file>

pdf.description: Also write a printable PDF worksheet to <file>

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter or a4 (default: letter)

solution.description: Print the solution instead of the puzzle

solutionPage.description: Omit the solution page from PDF output — set false to disable

tools.name: puzzle_sudoku_generate
tools.description: Generates a 9x9 sudoku at easy/medium/hard/expert difficulty. Every puzzle is verified to have exactly one solution. Deterministic with --seed. The canonical string format is 81 characters, row by row, "." for empty cells. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/sudoku

difficulty.description: One of: easy, medium, hard, expert (default: medium)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output (number or word)

svg.description: Also write an SVG image to <file>

pdf.description: Also write a printable PDF worksheet to <file>

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter or a4 (default: letter)

solution.description: Print the solution instead of the puzzle

solutionPage.description: Omit the solution page from PDF output — set false to disable

tools.name: puzzle_sudoku_solve
tools.description: Solves a 9x9 sudoku via backtracking. Input: 81 characters row by row with 1-9 for givens and 0/./_ for empty cells (whitespace and separators are ignored), passed inline, via --file, or on stdin. Reports whether the solution is unique. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/sudoku

file.description: Read the grid from a file

tools.name: puzzle_sudoku_validate
tools.description: Checks a 9x9 sudoku grid for well-formedness, conflicting givens, solvability, and whether the solution is unique (a proper sudoku has exactly one). Same input formats as sudoku solve. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/sudoku

file.description: Read the grid from a file

tools.name: puzzle_wordsearch_generate
tools.description: Places every word in a letter grid (8 possible directions, difficulty presets) and fills the rest with random letters. Deterministic with --seed. Words come from --words, --file (one per line), or --theme (bundled PuzzleTide word banks). Output: text grid, --json structured data, --svg image, or --pdf printable worksheet with solution page. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/word-search

file.description: Read words from a file (one per line or comma-separated)

theme.description: Use a bundled word bank theme (see: ptide words themes)

count.description: Number of words to use from the theme/file (default: 12)

size.description: Square grid size (6-30); computed from words if omitted

difficulty.description: Direction preset: easy (E,S), medium (+diagonals), hard (all 8) (default: medium)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output (number or word)

svg.description: Also write an SVG image to <file>

pdf.description: Also write a printable PDF worksheet to <file>

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter or a4 (default: letter)

solution.description: Print the solution instead of the puzzle

solutionPage.description: Omit the solution page from PDF output — set false to disable

tools.name: words_anagram
tools.description: Finds single-word anagrams of the given letters within the bundled word bank sample.

tools.name: words_categories
tools.description: Lists the bundled PuzzleTide word bank categories (animals, geography, holidays, ...) with their theme counts.

tools.name: words_list
tools.description: Prints the words of one bundled theme, optionally filtered by length, shuffled by --seed, and limited by --count. Useful as input for generators or other tools.

tools.name: words_match
tools.description: Matches the bundled word bank sample against a pattern where "_" or "?" is any letter, e.g. "c_r_l" matches CORAL. Helpful when stuck on a crossword or word puzzle.

tools.name: words_random
tools.description: Picks a random word from the bundled word banks — the same pool the hangman game uses. Deterministic with --seed.

tools.name: words_stats
tools.description: Prints the size of the bundled word bank: categories, themes, unique words.

tools.name: words_themes
tools.description: Lists the bundled starter themes (30 generic word lists; the full curated collection is at puzzletide.com). Filter by --category or full-text --search. Theme ids look like "animals/ocean-animals".

search.description: Full-text search over id, title, and description

instructions: Local-first puzzle tools: word search generator, crossword generator, sudoku generator/solver/validator, themed word banks, and verifiable puzzle evals for benchmarking. Puzzles are deterministic for a given seed. Never hand-write puzzle grids — these tools guarantee correctness. File-producing arguments (pdf, svg, out) take file paths and write printable worksheets. Online versions: https://puzzletide.com
